title: Combined all-flags launch preflight
reason: No accepted immutable launch flag manifest exists at this evidence snapshot. The surviving E04 and E06-E08 feature qualifications are unresolved, and E09 has no decided semantic posture.

evidence.fact: The definitive E01 aggregate and five-suite paired-draw machinery exist; E01 is not an E10 blocker.

launch_manifest_constraints.basis: E05 found zero strict SQL-statement reductions across 795 paired search samples and rejected the treatment.

blockers.fact: A launch manifest can be frozen only after every candidate feature has an accepted ship-or-drop outcome.
At source revision d989ae5893e24a14d11d51ad9c4cfc8c8b812e1b these experiments have not collectively produced the accepted feature set for the final launch manifest.

evidence.fact: E09 cannot run because E03 Mode 2 failed and its quality backfill was not run.

embeddings.note: If E09 later changes the semantic posture, the E10 procedure and embedding preflight must be revised before execution.

conclusion: E10 is not evaluated and supports no Tier C launch or cutover verdict. Keep the Tier C gate closed. Resolve E04 and E06-E09, exclude rejected features, then freeze and hash the exact accepted launch manifest before any E10 service or reasoning run.
